name: screen_control
description: Real mouse, keyboard and scroll control of this PC: click at coordinates or on the text you name (the screen is OCR'd, the words located, ISHTI clicks there), type text, press keys and hotkeys, scroll, move the mouse. Every click/type/scroll is shown to the owner and confirmed (T2) before it happens; reading the screen stays free.
route: click on something on my screen, press a key or hotkey, type this for me on the pc, scroll down/up, move the mouse, double click, right click
